description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget 'TransactionsScreen' which displays a list of financial transactions for a selected month. It uses Provider for state management, formats dates with intl, and includes UI elements such as a dropdown for month selection and a list of transaction items.

classes.name: TransactionsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays transactions grouped by month, allowing the user to select a month and view corresponding transactions.

methods.name: _formatMonth
methods.description: Formats a 'YYYY-MM' string to a more readable month format using intl's DateFormat.yMMM.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including a loading indicator, dropdown for month selection, and a list of transaction items.
